bullets.text: AI-Powered Doorbells Launch - **Amazon's Ring** introduces a controversial facial-recognition feature for video doorbells.
Traffic Alerts in Apple Maps - **iOS 26** enhances **Apple Maps** with proactive traffic delay alerts based on user routines.
AI in Dating Apps - **Hinge** CEO launches **Overtone**, an AI-driven dating app backed by **Match Group**.
AI Moratorium Controversy - Bipartisan backlash emerges against proposed AI moratorium amid rising regulatory concerns.
AI Chatbot Usage Among Teens - Study reveals 30% of US teens use AI chatbots daily, raising safety concerns.
New AI Features in Google Photos - **Google Photos** launches video editing tools for easier highlight reel creation.
AI Agents Standardization Effort - **OpenAI**, **Anthropic**, and **Block** join forces to standardize AI agents under the Linux Foundation.
Truecaller Enhances Scam Protection - **Truecaller** introduces a family-level scam protection feature to combat rising fraud.
Ford and Renault's EV Partnership - **Ford** teams up with **Renault** to develop affordable electric vehicles for Europe.
Rivian's AI Assistant Development - **Rivian** is building its own AI assistant, aiming for integration across vehicle controls.
